title: fix(cli): reject directory inputs with a clear error in upload and audio commands
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: The `polli upload`, `gen transcribe`, `gen isolate`, and `gen voice-change` commands now check that an input path is a regular file before reading it or making a request. Missing paths produce `error: File not found: <path>`; directories and other non-regular files produce `error: Not a file: <path>`. Both cases exit with code 1. A shared `requireFile` helper performs the check and returns the file size, avoiding a second stat call when upload sets `Content-Length`. The fix ships in `@pollinations/cli` 0.1.38, with eight new validation cases covering the four commands.
